data.title: Accident questionnaire from car insurer
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG wrote on 6 May 2026 about a liability claim from the 28 April 2026 traffic accident. You must return the completed questionnaire on how the accident happened within 10 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: The other party in the accident has made a claim against your motor liability insurance (Kfz-Haftpflicht). To clarify who is at fault, the insurer needs your account of what happened. Fill in the questionnaire and send it back within 10 working days (Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays) counted from the letter date; the app shows the date. The questionnaire itself was not included in the text provided, so check that you received it. If you miss the deadline, the insurer may have to assess fault without your account. Consider professional advice if fault is disputed.
